name.fr-FR: Politique tirée des propres paroles de l’Écriture sainte
name.en-US: Politics Drawn from the Very Words of Holy Scripture
name.pt-BR: Política tirada das próprias palavras da Sagrada Escritura

description.fr-FR: Traité en dix livres sur l’origine de la société, l’autorité, les devoirs des sujets et les devoirs du prince, déduit proposition par proposition de l’Écriture sainte. Écrit pour l’éducation du Dauphin (vers 1677-1679) et publié en 1709. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: A treatise in ten books on the origin of society, authority, the duties of subjects and the duties of the prince, deduced proposition by proposition from Holy Scripture. Written for the education of the Dauphin (around 1677-79) and published in 1709. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Tratado em dez livros sobre a origem da sociedade, a autoridade, os deveres dos súditos e os deveres do príncipe, deduzido proposição por proposição da Sagrada Escritura. Escrito para a educação do Delfim (por volta de 1677-1679) e publicado em 1709. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXIII, pages 012-016 (books I-V) and volume XXIV, pages 002-006 (books VI-X). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
